title: Private Cluster Maintenance Saga Map — interactive maintenance and risk canvas
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Design an interactive 'Maintenance Saga Map' for Private/VPC clusters: a horizontally scrolling timeline canvas that surfaces scheduled maintenance, upgrade waves, per-cluster risk exposure, estimated egress/cost impact, and quick mitigation actions. The canvas should support filtering by tenant, region, and maintenance type; allow operators to simulate canary windows and view downstream route/fallback behavior; and provide an exportable plan artifact for SRE handoffs. This ticket delivers high-fidelity prototypes and interaction specs for implementation by the Console team.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype covering: timeline overview, cluster detail flyout, rollout staging editor, and cost delta preview
Clickable mock that demonstrates: scheduling a canary window, escalating to full rollout, and triggering an emergency rollback action
Design spec with tokenized colors, accessibility contrast checks, and microcopy for all CTAs
Developer-ready redlines and a minimal component list (timeline bar, heatmap overlay, sparkline, action palette) linked in the attachments
PM and Eng signoff recorded in comments and linked PR for initial static rendering
design_decisions: Use a horizontal time-axis with variable zoom instead of vertical stacking to maximize chronological clarity for multi-cluster sequences
Represent risk as a semi-transparent heatmap overlay across the timeline to show temporal concentration of potential impact
Simplify controls: one primary action per cluster row (Plan / Execute / Revert) exposed on hover to reduce clutter
Show cost delta as an inline microcard that slides out on selection rather than persistent columns to save horizontal space
Defer detailed logs and metrics to the existing Cluster Health page via deep-links to avoid duplicating data surfaces
tradeoffs: Interactive simulation introduces complexity in data sync; chose optimistic local simulation with server reconciliation to keep responsiveness
Heatmap granularity set to 1h buckets to balance signal vs. rendering performance for large timelines
Inline rollback action requires tight guardrails; team agreed to limit immediate rollback to ops with a confirmation modal and audit log entry
Cost previews are approximate (estimated based on average token rates and egress tiers) to avoid blocking rollout; detailed billing left to Cost Explorer
